environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no IGW, no NAT). Accessible exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy restricting Principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/recommendation-engine-task-role. The endpoint's security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) allows inbound TCP 443 only from sg-0abcdef123456789 (the recommendation-engine service SG). Route tables for the subnet have no 0.0.0.0/0 route. DNS resolution for the service uses a Route53 private hosted zone (internal.acme.corp) that resolves only within the VPC. There is no public DNS record. The MongoDB connection uses IAM-based authentication with a scoped policy allowing only find operations on the 'users' collection.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate, private subnet, no IGW/NAT
config.endpoint_security_group: sg-0fedcba987654321 inbound TCP/443 from sg-0abcdef123456789 only
config.route_table: no 0.0.0.0/0 route, local VPC routes only
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, no public record
config.mongodb_auth: AWS IAM auth, policy scoped to mongodb:find on users collection only
config.public_accessibility: none - no internet path exists to reach the service
